text:
Twenty-seven students. One exam link. Anti-cheating switched on. And every result back on your screen — automatically.
Let's run a real online exam on Testoza, start to finish.
raw:
{m1}Twenty-seven students. {m2}One exam link. {m3}Anti-cheating switched on. {m4}And every result back on your screen — automatically.
{title}Let's run a real online exam on TestoZa, start to finish.

text:
Here's my test — the JEE Main mini mock we built in the last video.
To run it as a real exam, click Conduct exam.
raw:
Here's my test — {card}the JEE Main mini mock we built in the last video.
To run it as a real exam, {conduct}click Conduct exam.

text:
Testoza creates a private, secure link just for this exam.
It never shows up publicly — only people with this link can open it.
Start Conducting… and your exam is live.
raw:
TestoZa creates {link}a private, secure link just for this exam.
It never shows up publicly — only people with this link can open it.
{start}Start Conducting… {live}and your exam is live.

text:
See this little guide? Testoza walks you through it.
Step one: set up the exam room. Let's open Settings.
raw:
See this little guide? {coach}TestoZa walks you through it.
Step one: set up the exam room. {settings}Let's open Settings.

text:
This is your exam room. Three tabs: Proctoring, Access, and Results.
I'll go through every switch, the way I'd set it up for a real exam.
raw:
This is your exam room. Three tabs: {t1}Proctoring, {t2}Access, {t3}and Results.
I'll go through every switch, the way I'd set it up for a real exam.

text:
First — Force Full Screen.
The exam opens full screen, and if a student leaves it, that's counted as a violation.
For any serious test, switch this on.
raw:
First — {fs}Force Full Screen.
The exam opens full screen, and if a student leaves it, that's counted as a violation.
For any serious test, switch this on.

text:
Next, Tab and App Switch Detection.
Opening another tab, jumping to WhatsApp, minimising the browser — Testoza catches all of it.
raw:
Next, {tab}Tab and App Switch Detection.
Opening another tab, jumping to WhatsApp, minimising the browser — {caught}TestoZa catches all of it.

text:
Now decide what happens when they do.
Warn only — fine for a practice test.
Strict — the test submits on the very first switch.
Or my favourite: give a few warnings, then submit.
Three is fair. One notification can pop up by accident — three times is a habit.
And full-screen exits count toward the same limit.
raw:
Now decide what happens when they do.
{warn}Warn only — fine for a practice test.
{strict}Strict — the test submits on the very first switch.
Or my favourite: {count}give a few warnings, then submit.
{three}Three is fair. One notification can pop up by accident — three times is a habit.
And full-screen exits count toward the same limit.

text:
Disable Copy-Paste — so nobody pastes your question into Google or ChatGPT.
Disable Right Click — no menu, no quick search, no translate.
raw:
{copy}Disable Copy-Paste — so nobody pastes your question into Google or ChatGPT.
{right}Disable Right Click — no menu, no quick search, no translate.

text:
Block Back Button stops a student leaving the exam by accident.
And Disable Exit Button hides the exit, so nobody walks out halfway.
raw:
{back}Block Back Button stops a student leaving the exam by accident.
And {exit}Disable Exit Button hides the exit, so nobody walks out halfway.

text: Second tab: Access and Control.
raw: Second tab: {access}Access and Control.

text:
Scheduled Access opens and closes the exam at times you choose — perfect when the whole batch must start together.
We're starting right now, so I'll leave it off.
raw:
{sched}Scheduled Access opens and closes the exam at times you choose — {pickers}perfect when the whole batch must start together.
{schedoff}We're starting right now, so I'll leave it off.

text:
Assign to Class keeps this exam's results with the right batch.
Attempt Limit — one exam, one attempt. No retakes after seeing the paper.
And Require Candidate Login stays off for a class test.
Students just open the link, type their name, and start. No accounts. No app.
raw:
{class}Assign to Class keeps this exam's results with the right batch.
{attempt}Attempt Limit — one exam, one attempt. {single}No retakes after seeing the paper.
And {login}Require Candidate Login stays off for a class test.
Students just open the link, type their name, and start. No accounts. No app.

text: Last tab: Results and Timing.
raw: Last tab: {results}Results and Timing.

text:
Result Visibility — on, and students see their score and analysis the moment they submit.
Turn it off if you'd rather announce results later.
raw:
{vis}Result Visibility — on, and students see their score and analysis the moment they submit.
Turn it off if you'd rather announce results later.

text:
Strict Timer runs on our server.
Refresh the page, close the browser — the clock keeps running. Always on, for real exams.
raw:
{strictt}Strict Timer runs on our server.
Refresh the page, close the browser — the clock keeps running. Always on, for real exams.

text:
Allow Flexible Timer lets students switch the timer off.
Great for practice — and Testoza even warns you — but for an exam, keep it off.
raw:
{flex}Allow Flexible Timer lets students switch the timer off.
Great for practice — {flexwarn}and TestoZa even warns you — {flexoff}but for an exam, keep it off.

text:
Randomize Questions gives every student a different order —
so the person sitting next to them can't help.
raw:
{shuffle}Randomize Questions gives every student a different order —
so the person sitting next to them can't help.

text:
And finally, the exam screen itself.
Standard Mode looks just like the JEE and NEET computer-based test, with a question palette on the right.
Modern Mode is a clean, one-card-at-a-time layout.
For exam practice, I keep Standard.
raw:
And finally, {layout}the exam screen itself.
{std}Standard Mode looks just like the JEE and NEET computer-based test, with a question palette on the right.
{modern}Modern Mode is a clean, one-card-at-a-time layout.
{stdpick}For exam practice, I keep Standard.

text:
Save Settings… and look — the "Anti-cheating is off" warning is gone.
Your exam room is locked.

{save}Save Settings… and look — {chip}the "Anti-cheating is off" warning is gone.
Your exam room is locked.

text:
Now — who's writing? These are your candidate inputs.
Name is already there. Tap Roll No, and every result comes with a name and a roll number.

Now — who's writing? {inputs}These are your candidate inputs.
Name is already there. {roll}Tap Roll No, and every result comes with a name and a roll number.

text:
Step two: send it.
Copy the link… or share it straight to your class WhatsApp group.

{coach2}Step two: send it.
{copy2}Copy the link… {share}or share it straight to your class WhatsApp group.

Testoza writes the message for you — exam name, time, the link, and simple instructions.
Send.

{wa}TestoZa writes the message for you — {walines}exam name, time, the link, and simple instructions.
{send}Send.

text:
Not everyone's on WhatsApp — and sometimes you're standing in a classroom.
Open the menu, get a join code… and there it is. Six digits.

and the exam opens right in the browser. No app, no sign-up.

A paper that used to mean printing, invigilating, and a weekend of checking —
